sents.t: I don’t work, and I like waking up late.
But today I get up early, because Rosa and I want to go to the farmers market.
The market is in the town square every Saturday from eight to one.
Farmers from near Oakville sell their food there.
There are tomatoes, corn, peaches, honey, fresh flowers, and homemade bread.
A farmer gives me a piece of a peach.
I buy tomatoes, corn, and bread.
A man plays music on a banjo, and some children dance.
Max likes walking around the market.
One little girl gives him a piece of cheese.
At noon, we sit on a bench and eat fresh strawberries.
“Do you like the farmers market?” Rosa asks.
“I love it! Now I know my plan for every Saturday!”

o: every Saturday from eight to one
